summary: Lure package resolves sole dependency from off-registry Google Cloud Storage tarball
details: cxpw-offers ships an empty index.js and declares its only dependency `ltidisafe` as a direct tarball URL at https://ltidi.storage.googleapis.com/depenconf/ltidisafe-3.4.9.tgz, bypassing the npm registry. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs that off-registry tarball without integrity/hash pinning, executing whatever lifecycle scripts and module code it contains on the installer's machine. The package has no functional code of its own — the sole install-time effect is resolving and running attacker-controlled bytes from a third-party bucket. The path segment `depenconf` and the hollow main module are consistent with a dependency-confusion drop shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
